source.title: Kotov, HardwareX 26 (2026) e00767: An open-source test stand for backlash measurement in low-cost UART servo motors

independenceNote: Boris Kotov of Robonine, which sells the SO-ARM102 kit built on Feetech servos.
methodNote: Two STS3215 servos at default settings pull a 100 mm lever both ways; backlash is read on the servo's own output encoder, unloaded and under load. backlashArcmin holds the unloaded figure; the loaded one is in the note, and neither load is the protocol's ±5% of rated torque. ±5.3 arcmin is one count of the 4096-count encoder (0.088°), our reading resolution, not an uncertainty stated by the paper.

rig.torqueSensor: none (fixed pulling load from two servos)
rig.controller: Node.js controller over a USB-TTL adapter

note: Unloaded backlash about 0.62°; loaded about 1.30° (78 arcmin). Coupling two servos brought it to 0.47° to 0.67°.
